pain_points.label: Value proposition feels generic
pain_points.description: Stakeholders struggle to articulate how they are different, leading to inconsistent messaging across decks, landing pages, and SDR outreach.
pain_points.impact: Deals stall in discovery because prospects cannot map the offer to their priorities.
sample_signals: "Prospects keep asking how we're distinct from Competitor X."

pain_points.label: Lead generation drop-off
pain_points.description: MQL volume is steady, but nurture programs do not move buyers to the sales conversation, and dormant leads rarely re-engage.
pain_points.impact: Marketing spend increases but pipeline coverage shrinks, forcing higher CAC.
sample_signals: "Automation rules are still manual exports + blasts."
"Our call-to-actions are being ignored after the first touch."

pain_points.label: Limited analytics & attribution
pain_points.description: Leadership lacks trusted self-serve dashboards, and every board update requires ad hoc spreadsheet wrangling.
pain_points.impact: Teams cannot prove which initiatives work, so budgets freeze and experimentation slows.
sample_signals: "Finance and marketing show different numbers for the same campaign."
"We have GA4 tags everywhere but no clean funnel report."

pain_points.label: Manual processes slow fulfillment
pain_points.description: Hand-offs across CS, operations, and finance rely on spreadsheets and email, creating bottlenecks and SLA risk.
pain_points.impact: Customer onboarding drags on, and teams cannot scale without headcount.
sample_signals: "Rep hand-off notes live in their personal notebooks."
"We triple-check each invoice because the numbers are keyed manually."

pain_points.label: Website underperforms
pain_points.description: The marketing site feels dated, loads slowly, and fails to convert mobile traffic, hurting first impressions.
pain_points.impact: Prospects bounce before sales engagement, depressing inbound pipeline quality.
sample_signals: "Bounce rate on pricing is north of 80%."
"Half our catalog images look fuzzy on retina displays."
